evidence.title: Rapier determinism guide
evidence.claim: Enhanced determinism mode is designed for reproducible results across IEEE-754 targets, including WASM.

evidence.title: Rapier joints and motors
evidence.claim: Rapier supports articulated joints, limits, and motor controls required by the model.

evidence.title: wasm-bindgen boundary documentation
evidence.claim: Rust/WASM modules can expose a typed JavaScript boundary suitable for worker integration.

evidence.title: Web Workers API
evidence.claim: Dedicated workers support off-main-thread computation and message-based progress/result flow.

evidence.title: Service Worker API
evidence.claim: Service workers can provide offline shell support after first successful online load.

evidence.title: IndexedDB API
evidence.claim: IndexedDB supports structured local persistence needed for scenarios and run records.

evidence.title: Playwright projects
evidence.claim: Playwright project matrices support cross-browser workflows and deterministic validation checks.

evidence.title: React 19 release notes
evidence.claim: React 19 is a stable baseline for the UI contract in this project.

evidence.title: Vite guide and browser support
evidence.claim: Vite supports static asset builds, workers, and modern browser targets for this stack.

evidence.title: Web app dependency baselines
evidence.claim: React 19.2.8, React Router 8.3.0, Vite 8.2.2, Dexie 4.4.5, Zustand 5.0.15, and Zod 4.4.3 are pinned.

evidence.title: Physics crate dependency baselines
evidence.claim: Rust 1.98.0 and rapier2d 0.35.2 with enhanced determinism are pinned in the physics crate.

evidence.title: Specification gate requirements
evidence.claim: Hard gates require determinism, worker isolation, offline operation, accessibility, and browser matrix coverage.

evidence.title: Candidate and risk comparison
evidence.claim: Selected and alternative candidates are documented with constraints, risks, and revisit triggers.

evidence.title: Native, WASM, and browser physics evidence
evidence.claim: Determinism, parity, convergence, exclusions, telemetry, solve latency, and cancellation gates pass.

evidence.title: Browser and offline spike evidence
evidence.claim: Automated engine workflows, offline reload, accessibility, provenance, visual framing, latency, and frame pacing pass.

evidence.title: Designer offline route evidence
evidence.claim: The canonical Designer route and legacy pose replacement redirect work without network access.

evidence.title: Compatibility registry report
evidence.claim: Current scenario, protocol, frame-layout, and persistence versions are accepted and unknown versions are rejected.

evidence.title: Dependency and security release checks
evidence.claim: Lock integrity, declared licenses, vulnerability audit, secret scan, and CycloneDX SBOM generation pass.
